launches.body:
**Hey everyone!**

We're Vishnu and Chrisvin, the co-founders of Tepali.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zt2O8-s3Alo>

**TL;DR**

Tepali is the AI EMR for medspas & wellness clinics. Front desk, charting, point of sale, and marketing in one system, with an AI employee that books new leads, charts every appointment, and brings past clients back.

**The problem**

A medspa runs on ten to twelve disconnected tools: one for booking, another for charting, another for payments, texting, marketing, and inventory. None of them talk to each other. The gaps between them get filled with the owner's time: missed calls, after-hours charting, and leads that go cold before anyone follows up.

Most of that software was built for salons, before AI. Even the all-in-one platforms digitize the manual work instead of doing it.

**What Tepali does**

First, one system for the whole practice: front desk, EMR, point of sale, and marketing. Scheduling, the client record, charts, consent forms, inventory, payments, memberships, and every text, call, and Instagram DM live in the same place.

Then an AI employee that works across all of it, at every stage of the visit:

**Before the visit, it books new leads.** It answers every call and text 24/7. Leads from ads, Instagram DMs, and website forms get a reply in seconds, and it converses with each one until they book a consultation. Every conversation lands in one unified inbox, so your front desk sees the whole thread.

**During the visit, it charts every appointment.** An ambient scribe listens to the treatment and writes a complete, service-specific chart as it happens, so charts are done without taking up provider time. Charting is built for injectables: injection maps on the client's own before photos, consent forms sent automatically, Good Faith Exam tracking, and inventory deducted by unit and lot.

**After the visit, it brings past clients back.** It reaches out to clients who are due for their next treatment, recovers no-shows, fills cancellations from the waitlist, and requests reviews. Checkout fills the cart from the visit, with memberships, packages, gift cards, and card readers at the counter.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98330&key=user_uploads/2145173/726ff95e-085c-4c19-8c27-bfeb944afc36)

**Who it's for**

Medspas and aesthetics practices (injectables, lasers, skin), and wellness clinics: IV therapy, medical weight loss, hormone therapy, peptides, and longevity. All are cash-pay medical businesses that need charting, consent, and inventory tracking.

**The team**

We're best friends who grew up together and have spent our careers inside this exact problem.

Vishnu studied CS at Carnegie Mellon and led engineering at MealPal (Series B). At Dripos (YC S20), he built the all-in-one point of sale used by thousands of coffee shops and saw how much a service business changes when its software finally works as one system.

Chrisvin studied at NYU Stern and executed $30B in M&A at PJT Partners. He then scaled operations at Rilla, a vertical AI unicorn, where he saw what happens when AI is applied to high-ticket service industries.
